name: Poslednij geroj
source: When creating this mod, I wanted to make it special, at least by sending a completely different person to the Sovenok pioneer camp, unrelated to the characters in the original story. A man with an unusual past and present, who would live his life in his own time, without even imagining that in the future, fate might connect him with such a wonderful place. It would seem that everything is obvious - the main character needs to spend only one shift in a Soviet pioneer camp and draw some conclusions for himself: how he lived; what he considered right for himself.; Did he know what might be lurking in himself all this time? But in this case, this is just one of several endings of this story. The true purpose of the "Last Hero" is to change and save the "Owl" from himself, but it's up to you to decide whether he can do it.
translation: 在创建这个模组时，我想让它变得特别，至少派一个完全不同的人到索维诺克先锋营，与原始故事中的角色无关。一个有着不同寻常的过去和现在的人，他会在自己的时代里过着自己的生活，却没有想到，在未来，命运会把他和这样一个美好的地方联系在一起。似乎一切都是显而易见的——主角只需要在苏联先锋营待上一班，就可以为自己得出一些结论：他是如何生活的；他是如何生活的；他认为适合自己的事情。他知道自己身上一直潜伏着什么吗？但在这种情况下，这只是这个故事的几个结局之一。“最后的英雄”的真正目的是改变并拯救“猫头鹰”，但他能否做到这一点取决于你。
